exercises.instructionUz: Gap pufakchalarini ro'yxatdagi gaplar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ILTIMOS qolipi: Can you + FE'L + ... , please?

'please' iltimosning muloyimligini oshiradi va odatda OXIRIDA,
vergul bilan ajratilib keladi.

DIQQAT — bu yerda 'can' QOBILIYAT emas:
  'Can you swim?'      → qobiliyat (suza olasizmi?)
  'Can you help me?'   → iltimos (yordam bera olasizmi?)
Farqni VAZIYAT aytib beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in the missing words. Then, listen and check. In pairs, act out similar dialogues using your name, address and phone number.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va yetishmayotgan so'zlarni to'ldiring. So'ng eshitib tekshiring. Juftlikda o'z ismingiz, manzilingiz va telefon raqamingiz bilan shunga o'xshash dialog tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ro'yxatdan o'tish (ro'yxatga yozilish) suhbati. To'rtta ma'lumot so'raladi:
  1) ism    — What's your name?
  2) yosh   — How old are you?
  3) manzil — What's your home address?
  4) telefon — What's your phone number?

RASMIY muloqot belgilari:
  • madam / sir — xonim / janob (mijozga murojaat)
  • Certainly — Albatta (Yes dan muloyimroq)
  • I'd like to ... — ...moqchiman (I want dan muloyimroq)
  • Of course — Albatta

exercises.explanationUz:
HARFLAB AYTISH — telefon va ro'yxatga yozilishda juda kerak.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA: bir xil harf IKKI marta kelsa, 'double' deyiladi:
  Anna    → A - DOUBLE N - A

Bu ingliz tilida majburiy emas, lekin tabiiy va tez.

items.whyUz: Qobiliyat so'ralyapti → Can. Gap boshida katta harf.
'hear from you' — sizdan xabar olmoq. E'lon oxiridagi ibora.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the sentences to the pictures. Which express ability? Which express a polite request?
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni rasmlarga moslang. Qaysilari qobiliyatni, qaysilari muloyim iltimosni bildiradi?
exercises.explanationUz:
'can' ning IKKI ma'nosini ajratish — bu betning asosiy maqsadi.

QOBILIYAT (ability): EGA + can + FE'L
  'Ann can use the computer very well.' — Ann kompyuterdan yaxshi foydalana oladi.
  Bu yerda gap odamning MAHORATI haqida.

ILTIMOS (polite request): Can YOU + FE'L ... , please?
  'Can you sign here, please?' — Shu yerga imzo cheka olasizmi?
  Bu yerda kimdandir NIMADIR SO'RALYAPTI.

Ajratish usuli: so'roq bo'lsa va 'please' bo'lsa — iltimos.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Iltimos qilish va ro'yxatdan o'tish — amaliy muloqot qoliplari.

patterns.exampleEn: Can you read this for me, please?
patterns.explanationUz: 'please' oxirida, vergul bilan. Buyruq gapdan ('Read this') ancha muloyim.

patterns.exampleEn: Ann can use the computer very well.
patterns.exampleUz: Ann kompyuterdan juda yaxshi foydalana oladi.
patterns.explanationUz: So'roq emas, 'please' yo'q — demak bu qobiliyat, iltimos emas.

patterns.exampleEn: How do you spell it? — A - double N - A ... H - U - G - H - E - S.

patterns.explanationUz: Ism va familiya orasida qisqa pauza. Ikkilangan harf uchun 'double'.

patterns.formula: RO'YXAT: What's your name/address? · How old are you? · What's your phone number?
patterns.exampleEn: What's your home address? — 7, Green Street.
patterns.explanationUz:
Manzil ingliz tilida TESKARI tartibda: uy raqami → ko'cha → shahar.
O'zbekchada 'Green ko'chasi, 7-uy', inglizchada '7, Green Street'.

patterns.formula: XIZMAT: Can I help you? → Yes please. I'd like to ...
patterns.exampleEn: Can I help you? — Yes please. I'd like to join the tennis club.
patterns.exampleUz: Yordam bera olamanmi? — Ha, iltimos. Tennis klubiga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.
patterns.explanationUz: Do'kon, klub, bankda eng ko'p eshitiladigan savol. Javobda 'I'd like to' — muloyim shakl.
